_comment: Generated by scripts/capture-screenshots.js. Images are `format` (WebP). The `galleryLocale` folder contains the full `screens` set; every other locale folder contains only `storeScreens`. Render docs/screenshots/<locale>/<screen>.<format>. `screens` is the full gallery set; `storeScreens` is the curated subset shown on the homepage / shipped in the Roku store listing (capped at 6). storeLocales is the curated subset of locales that ships in the store listing.
